# Sustainable Bond Diligence Agent

> Separates underlying credit, contractual protections, label integrity, verified impact and relative value before a buy-side investment decision. Institutional-quality buy-side research, designed to support tradable investment decisions through a traceable, auditable workflow.

Prepared software package v0.1.0, by HHFinAi. No embedded model, live feed, automatic trade execution or independent certification. Optional navigation only; not a guaranteed indexing mechanism.
